messages:
nora (devex): quick one from support: customer used SSO to sign up, ran `ri quickstart` and got `402 Payment Required`. They say the web signup flow never showed billing; workspace wasn't created. CLI then retried for ~3 minutes and blocked CI.

kevin (support): User logs show: `POST /v1/firstcall -> 402` then repeated `retrying request` lines. They also ran `ri account status` and got `billing_state: needs_action` and `workspace: null`. They pasted org id.

ash (sdk): That sounds like a parity bug. Our retry middleware treats non-network 4xx as retryable unless explicitly blacklisted. SSO signups sometimes leave org in 'needs_action' where billing must be completed by an admin. Retrying just masks the true error.

nora (devex): From a DX angle we should: 1) surface the org id and required action in the CLI message, 2) fast-fail (no retries) for 401/402, 3) provide an SSO-specific hint: "Ask your org admin to complete billing at <billing link>". Also include a short KB snippet for support to copy into replies.

ash (sdk): I'll patch the retry policy to mark 401/402 terminal across Node/Go/Python and add a CLI-friendly error formatter for blocked orgs. Opening RD-7701 and PRs: node-sdk#823, go-sdk#506.

kevin (support): For the immediate case I told user: run `ri account status` and `ri admin whoami` to find the org admin, then follow the billing link. If they can't reach admin, escalate with org id and signup timestamp.

ops-bot: Staging deploy queued: ri-cli v0.11.0-beta (includes 402 fast-fail and clearer SSO billing hint). Smoke test: quickstart-sso-block.json.

ash (sdk): Also adding an integration test that simulates SSO-created orgs with `needs_action` billing_state to assert CLI prints admin hint and exits within 1s. Will add lint rule to prevent future retry regressions for client errors.

nora (devex): Great. Can we also add a tiny telemetry event `cli.onboarding.blocked` with `reason: billing` and `signup_flow: sso|email` so we can see if SSO signups are more affected?

ash (sdk): yes, I'll add the telemetry and a Grafana panel.

kevin (support): closing loop with customer: shared steps and told them we'll follow up after the PR lands. I also flagged for Product since some orgs expect free trials post-SSO and we should confirm signup UX.

nora (devex): assigning RD-7701 to me for KB write-up and to track support occurrences. Thanks all. :memo:
